description: This file contains integration tests for the DataTable functionality within the Apache Fineract project. It includes setup procedures, and multiple test cases for creating, reading, updating, deleting datatables and their entries, including cases for null values, case sensitivity, multi-row datatables, and error conditions.

classes.name: DatatableIntegrationTest
classes.description: This class contains integration tests for DataTable operations including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and querying within the Fineract system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including REST client setup and helper instances.

methods.name: validateCreateReadDeleteDatatable
methods.description: Tests the lifecycle of creating, reading, and deleting a datatable, including validation errors for invalid input.

methods.name: validateCreateReadDeleteDatatableWithCaseSensitive
methods.description: Tests datatable operations with case-sensitive column names and verifies correct behavior.

methods.name: validateInsertNullValues
methods.description: Tests inserting null or empty values into datatable entries and verifies handling of nulls.

methods.name: validateCreateAndEditDatatable
methods.description: Tests creation of a datatable, insertion, updating columns and entries, and subsequent cleanup.

methods.name: validateReadDatatableMultirow
methods.description: Tests operations on multi-row datatables, including creation, entry insertion, retrieval, and validation.
